w: Naresh Roy from Canada, the architect Arun Pradhan and his Greek partner George came for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Nareshbhai described the current state of the new mandir being built by the organisation in Canada. He showed the plans. Throughout the meeting Swamishri kept turning his mala. At the end he gave that mala to George and taught him how to turn it.
Naresh Roy said, "Our wish is that we make George a Hindu."

Swamishri said, "He is vegetarian and stays so, so he has already become a Hindu. If he stays vegetarian and has no addictions in his life, he is a Hindu. We do not convert people's religion as others do. We transform lives."

When this religious outlook of Swamishri's was explained to George, he was very pleased. He said, "What you say is absolutely right. It is not religious conversion but transformation of life that should happen."
Swamishri does not believe in converting religion through the grip of money, the fear of a pistol or any other means. He only wishes that this soul's life be blessed.

Prior to his morning puja, Swamishri was welcomed by kishores seated in a heart-shaped arrangement on the mandir grounds. To declare the Kishore Day Swamishri released a bunch of balloons.
In the evening assembly a drama presentation by kishores, 'Sabse Unchi Prem Sagai', depicted the healing love of a God communion sadhu.

In the presence of Swamishri, the foundation stone-laying ceremony, and for some, the ground-breaking ceremony of seven new mandirs in the Sabarkantha District was held. The donor of the land were blessed and appreciated by Swamishri. The soil from the following places were brought for the ceremony:
Bhadresar, Idar region
Adpodara, Himmatnagar region
Gaambhoi, Himmatnagar region
Prempur, Himmatnagar region
Khaari, near Shamalaji, Liloda region
Talod, Talod region
Swamishri performed the yagna rituals in which 561 devotees participated around 70-yagna kunds. After the pujan rituals Swamishri performed arti and offered a coconut into the main yagna kund.
From 3.30 p.m. The procession was welcomed enthusiastically by the local people as it passed through the main streets.

At 10.00 am Swamishri departed from Mahesana and arrived at 10.45 am in Kalol. Swamishri attended a public satsang assembly. In his blessings Swamishri said, “Bhagwan Swaminarayan had not preached about religious conversion but about transforming the evil nature of people. This is social service. What the law cannot do, religion can. The injunctions of our shastras are true. People who do not abide by them are being errant and wayward… By going to the mandir our mind becomes steady. The mind is restless like a monkey. To make it calm we have God, who is steady and calm. We have achieved external progress, but for the progress of atma we have dharma and our scriptures. To steady the wavering mind one should read the shastras and listen to discourses of sadhus” After the assembly Swamishri arrived at the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir in Kalol and performed pujan and arti of the murtis.

In the late afternoon Swamishri departed from Kalol and travelled to Vidyanagar for the 40th anniversary celebration of Akshar Purushottam Chhatralay (APC). The celebration marked forty successful years of the Chhatralay since its inauguration by Yogiji Maharaj on 20 June 1965. Swamishri was welcomed by ex-students of APC and senior sadhus. In his blessings Swamishri narrated the history of the making of the Chhatralay, “It was Yogiji Maharaj’s wish to build a Chhatralay. Ambalal Kalyan Yojna donated the land. Then the youths and sadhus dug the foundation pit… Yogiji Maharaj desired that youths should have character and academic excellence. This would help create a better society. One should not be tinged by the colours of materialism…” Swamishri would be presiding during the 2½ day celebration.

SWAMISHRI WOKE UP AT 2.30 AM AND ATTENDed the lunar eclipse assembly. The assembly commenced with dhun in the presence of 7,000 devotees. Thereafter Viveksagar Swami spoke about the history and significance of an eclipse. This was followed by a programme of kirtan antakshari in which two groups of sadhus competed by singing verses of bhajans. Swamishri responded with divine gestures during the exciting antakshari programme. The senior sadhus were asked to narrate incidents that they would like to have been present in from the lives of Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Thereafter Krishnapriya Swami presented a programme on the bhajan “Dikhalã didãr pyãrã…” Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, “Today, we are observing an eclipse. The devout observe this in pilgrim places like Haridwar and Rishikesh and then bathe in the river Ganga. During the eclipse the moon is being put to misery by evil forces, therefore we pray to redeem it.

“Often, due to perceiving manushyabhav in the life of the Satpurush one does not have faith in the words of the Satpurush and the shastras. Subsequently, we are unable to accomplish our tasks. We then feel that God is not the doer. This lack of faith within grows. However, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj had absolute faith in Shriji Maharaj and all their works were accomplished. They believed that Maharaj is doing the work and it is being done through his will; he is the all-doer. So they never retreated in the face of obstacles.” The lunar eclipse concluded at 6.45 am. At 7.25 am Swamishri performed his puja, then he went for Thakorji’s darshan.

At 5.40 pm Swamishri arrived at the Fuldol celebration assembly. The stage backdrop was themed on the BAPS centenary year in which a large flag of BAPS spanned from one end to the other. In the middle the murtis of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj were enshrined inside a replica of the Akshar Deri. Large pots overflowing with colour and giant pichkaris reflected the rangotsav flavour. The theme of the festival celebration was “Sadguru khele vasant…” Viveksagar Swami narrated about how Gunatitanand Swami spread the colour of Bhagwan Swaminarayan’s supreme glory, Adarshjivan Swami elaborated upon Bhagatji Maharaj’s colour of obedience, Ishwarcharan Swami discoursed about how Shastriji Maharaj established the colour of Akshar-Purushottam upasana, Dr Swami explained how Yogiji Maharaj spread the colour of samp, suhrudbhav and ekta and Mahant Swami talked about the colour of Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s guru bhakti. Then Swamishri inaugurated a BAPS video publication ‘Satsang Darshan, Pt 72’. A rendering of Pramukh Swami Maharaj: Life and Work in Tamil and Pragji Bhakta (exam book) in Marathi were also inaugurated. Thereafter, sadhus sang “Yogi ãvo te rang mane shid lagãdyo.”

Finally, Swamishri blessed the festival assembly of 42,000 devotees and 6,000 volunteers, “Sadaiva Sãrangpurasya ramie, sumandire hyakshardham tulye… In such a divine place God forever resides with his abode. Sadaiva means forever. Shastriji Maharaj’s work is for eternity. Ramya means blissful. Whenever one comes here one feels happy. The reason being that Shriji Maharaj, the presiding deity of Akshar-dham, came to this village. “A dignitary today may hesitate in coming to a village of this size because there are no arrangements to his requirement and satisfaction; and (200 years ago) there were no arrangements of water, electricity and other amenities. And Shriji Maharaj came here with his abode (Gunatitanand Swami) and his muktas. God is thus great because he never forgets the poorest and most ordinary souls. He came to fulfil the wishes of his devotees and celebrated the Fuldol festival here. At that time the female devotees prayed, ‘Mahabalavant mãyã tamari…’ “To transcend maya God said, ‘Come and accept my refuge and believe me to be pure.’ Maharaj came to this little village and talked about his philosophy. Shriji Maharaj enquired about the nature of jiva, ishwar, maya, Brahman and Parabrahman during his seven-year sojourn. But no one could give him a correct explanation. Maharaj explained about Brahman and Parabrahman, where the former is his abode and the latter is himself. To liberate oneself from maya one has to identify oneself with Brahman and offer upasana to Parabrahman. “In this world one will experience happiness and misery, heat and shade, and honour and insult. This will occur despite having an association of God or his Sadhu. To liberate oneself one has to imbibe knowledge and a spiritual understanding. When one is blessed with the association of God’s abode then one will be able to accept both heat and shade equally. Even in that one shall remain happy and be able to offer bhakti to God.” At 7.05 pm Swamishri performed pujan of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj who was pedestalled on a golden elephant. Thereafter he performed arti and sprayed coloured water on Harikrishna Maharaj. From a little spray in the hands of Harikshrina Maharaj coloured water issued forth towards Swamishri. Then Swamishri sprayed holy coloured water on the dignitaries and devotees.
On taking Swamishri’s echocardiogram Dr Lotlikar said that after one-and-a-half months of treatment and rest Swamishri’s heart is healthy.
During Swamishri’s morning puja kishores demonstrated the troubles Swamishri has taken in spreading Satsang. They also performed a traditional dance.

5 March 2009, (V.S. 2065, Sud Nom Shri Hari Navmi) Thusday, Bhavnagar & Sarangpur Annakut was offered to Thakorji in the central shrine, a variety of fruits were offered to Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj and different vegetables ( shakotsav ) were arranged before Shri Harikrishna Maharaj in the mandir shrine.

A parayan was being held here in memory of the late wife of Shri Chhotubhai Ajmera. His Dubai-based partner, Shri Nasar, had also come to take part in this parayan. Nasar is an Arab, but he has immense respect for Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He was also going to stay here during the five-day parayan.

Of his own accord he wished to give up cigarettes, so today he told Swamishri about it. He can understand a little Hindi, so Swamishri said (in Hindi), "You have made a very good resolve. Sarangpur is also a good place. You have affection for satsang, this is a holy place and the parayan is also going on, so today make your resolve firm and give up cigarettes here. Do your business, but do not smoke cigarettes." He felt fulfilled by Swamishri's blessings.

ds.t: So that punishment is not needed
w: Atmadarshan Swami had sent a special gift from Vidyanagar. At the end of it he had prayed, "Just as Yamraj gave Nachiketa the knowledge of Brahman, we too are in your college of the knowledge of Brahman, so if necessary, even by punishing us, teach us your knowledge of Brahman."
Hariprakash Swami, who was reading this prayer, said, "If necessary, punish us too."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj immediately said, "Make it so that it never has to be given! Keep simplicity in life. Live according to our wishes and instructions, and engage in bhajan and devotion."

Because of low rainfall last season, the Yagnapurush lake here had dried up and its bottom could be seen. In this context the sadhus requested Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "Please stay here until the dam here fills. When the dam fills, these roses and jasmines in the form of sadhus will blossom and stay green."

Giving this a spiritual turn, Swamishri said, "Make it so they stay green even without water! If they learn to stay the same in honour and insult, stay in constant joy, and live as in 'Jya juo tya Ramji, dusro na bhase re...' (wherever you look, there is Ramji, nothing else appears), then there will be no green or dry at all."
Hariprakash Swami said, "If you bless us, such a state will come."
"How many blessings should I give?"
"We are only ordinary souls, but since we have come to you, please bring us to such a state."

Swamishri said, "Make devotion firm in your life. Stay at peace in honour and insult, in happiness and misery, in everything. If one reaches such a state, nothing more needs to be said. Live in such a way that you understand the glory of everyone, and do katha, bhajan, kirtan and seva."

A parayan (scripture recitation) was being held here in memory of the late wife of Shri Chhotubhai Ajmera. His partner based in Dubai, Shri Nasser, had also come to take part. Nasser is an Arab, but has great respect for Swamishri. He was to stay here during the five day parayan.

Of his own accord he wished to give up cigarettes, so today he spoke of it before Swamishri. He can understand a little Hindi, so Swamishri said, "You have made a very good resolve. Sarangpur is a good place too. You have love for satsang, this is a holy place, and a parayan is going on, so today make your resolve firm and give up cigarettes here. Do business, but do not smoke cigarettes." He felt fulfilled by Swamishri's blessings.

ds.t: Make it so punishment is never needed
w: Atmadarshan Swami had sent a special gift from Vidyanagar. At the end it carried a prayer: "Just as Yamaraja gave Brahmavidya to Nachiketa, we too are in your college of Brahmavidya, so if needed, teach us your Brahmavidya even by punishing us."
Reading this prayer, Hariprakash Swami said, "If needed, give punishment too."
Swamishri said at once, "Make it so that it never needs to be given! Keep simplicity in life. Live by His wishes and His commands, and do bhajan and devotion."

Because of low rainfall last time, the Yagnapurush lake here had run dry and its bed was showing. With this in mind the sadhus requested Swamishri, "Please stay here until the dam here fills. If the dam fills, these sadhus, like roses and jasmine, will bloom and stay green."

Giving the same words a spiritual turn, Swamishri said, "Make it so you stay green even without water! Learn to stay the same in honour and insult, stay in constant joy, and live as 'Wherever you look there is Ramji, nothing else appears...'; then there is no green and dry at all."
Hariprakash Swami said, "If you bless us, such a state will come."
"How many blessings should I give?"
"We are only jivas, but we have come to you, so please give us such a state."

Swamishri said, "Make devotion firm in life. Let there be peace and only peace in honour and insult, happiness and sorrow. If such a state comes, nothing needs to be said. Live so that you understand the greatness of each person, and discourses, bhajan, kirtan and seva happen."
While Mahant Swami Maharaj was having his meal, a sadhu asked him, "We go to hold assemblies in rural areas. Is there any message or teaching you would like to give there?"
"Unity." In a word, Swamishri gave the essential message. Then he added, "It just came in 'Yogicharitam', didn't it? 'A spirit of togetherness'. Keep such a spirit of togetherness."
It was as if Swamishri sent this message flowing out for all the devotees of the organisation.
